$comment: Rules for check-artifact-format.mjs. Schema and rule ids are documented in that script's header. Section names are matched case-insensitively, trimmed, trailing ':' ignored; a list in place of a name means any one of those alternatives.

standard.$comment: The planned house format (TKT-47): thesis, Summary first, Behavior or Business Process, at most 5 technical sections, References last when present. Notes have no word budget, on purpose.

problem-proposal.$comment: The Problem -> Proposal -> Acceptance shape that Story tickets use on the odnf board. Many existing tickets (Epics, Spikes, older ones) do not follow it, so a gate should pick a preset per issue type and start in warn mode. pr matches the open-pr skill's body template. Notes have no word budget, on purpose.
